jobs.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Corporate Development function at Wealthsimple is a small but high-impact team responsible for accelerating the company’s growth through mergers & acquisitions, strategic investments, and strategic partnerships. We’re looking for someone who can seamlessly swing between corporate strategy projects to identify avenues for scalable growth and tactical deal execution to catalyze our highest priorities. You will work with product, engineering, and business leadership to identify, evaluate, and execute on inorganic growth opportunities that give our company access to best-in-class product, technology, and talent.  You will own the development of rigorous analyses to evaluate build / buy / partner scenarios with the goal of providing strategic recommendations to the leadership team. This is a great role for someone who is an innovative thinker and wants to help bend the company’s growth trajectory.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

 - Partner with leaders across the company to identify strategic opportunities that can accelerate our product roadmap and business strategy

 - Be a subject matter expert on the competitive landscape and industry trends; leverage your market insights to develop the business case for growth opportunities via product expansion or partnership distribution strategies

 - Lead qualitative and quantitative analyses including build / buy / partner considerations, financial forecasting, and valuation modeling

 - Manage all stages of a deal process - including inbound / outbound sourcing, deal assessment, valuation, negotiations, due diligence, structuring, closing processes, and post-deal integration - while coordinating across a large cross-functional team

 - Collaborate and build relationships with internal stakeholders across all functions and seniority levels, as well as with external parties in our ecosystem (VCs, founders, investment banks, etc.)
   
   


WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - 7+ years of relevant work experience in corporate development, investment banking, venture capital, or private equity

 - Proactive ownership mindset and can thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment

 - Passion for high growth tech, FinTech, and traditional FinServices

 - Ability to think strategically and leverage a combination of critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, business judgment, and product intuition

 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses

 - Superior financial modeling and valuation skills (including DCF, comps analysis, etc.)

 - High EQ and interpersonal skills to cultivate relationships internally and externally

 - Ability to balance multiple high-priority projects and collaborate / coordinate across large cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills (verbal + written) and can deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

 - Partner with product and engineering to shape the roadmap and infrastructure needed to scale Wealthsimple's investment access capabilities over time

 - Develop compelling strategic narratives and business cases that align senior leadership on participation decisions and longer-term market opportunities

About the People Systems & Operations Team:

The People Systems and Operations team builds and operates the systems, workflows, and automations the business runs on. We manage every stage of the employee lifecycle and own the design and optimization of the processes behind it. We're accountable for the reliability, scale, and integrity of our People systems.

What you bring to the system:

 - Configure and maintain Payroll: pay components, earnings and deductions, pay groups, period schedules, and payroll-related business processes

 - Configure and maintain Absence: time-off plans, accrual rules, eligibility criteria, and leave types

 - Configure and maintain Time Tracking: time entry templates, validations, work calendars, and overtime calculations

 - Configure and maintain Core HCM foundations: supervisory organizations, staffing models, job profiles and job/compensation structures, custom organizations, and worker data integrity

 - Support annual and recurring People cycles in Workday, including compensation reviews, open enrollment configuration, and org restructures (mass supervisory org changes and job catalog updates)

 - Design, build, and maintain business process definitions in both domains, including condition rules, calculated fields, custom validations, routing and approval logic, and notifications

 - Partner with the Payroll team to troubleshoot configuration-driven payroll issues, including gross-to-net discrepancies, retro calculations, and off-cycle errors — the Payroll team owns processing; you own the configuration behind it

 - Bring a strong command of the Workday security model: role-based, user-based, and intersection security groups, domain security policies, business process security policies, and integration system users (ISUs), with sound judgment about when to leverage each as you configure and troubleshoot across domains

 - Support security and data audits in partnership with the broader team, using Workday delivered and custom audit reports to analyze access patterns, remediate exceptions, and uphold segregation of duties

 - Perform impact analysis before changes ship, including how HCM and security changes ripple into payroll, absence, and time data



What you bring to the business:

 - Translate business requirements from our internal partners into scalable system design, and document configuration decisions as you go

 - Build trusted relationships with partner teams, acting as a translator between technical configuration and business needs

 - Support change management for system updates and new functionality: communicate what's changing and why, prepare documentation and enablement materials, and make sure changes land well with the people who use them

 - Build and maintain advanced, matrix, and composite reports and dashboards; support mass data changes via EIB

 - Configure alerts, scheduled reports, and report security so the right data reaches the right people automatically

 - Triage and resolve day-to-day system issues, getting to root cause rather than patching symptoms

 - Actively look for where AI and automation can strengthen how People Systems works, from testing, documentation, and requirements drafting to ticket triage and report generation, using Anthropic's own tools as part of your daily workflow

 - Drive process automation and optimization opportunities with the broader People team and partner functions



Qualifications:

 - 7+ years of experience as a Workday Business Systems Analyst, with demonstrated expertise in system configuration, testing, and implementation

 - Workday Pro accreditations or Workday partner certifications in HCM, Payroll, Absence, Time Tracking

 - Exposure to Workday Prism Analytics, Extend, or advanced reporting beyond standard report writer

 - Experience applying AI tools to HRIS or People operations work, or strong interest in building that muscle

 - Have deep hands-on working knowledge of Workday Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking (PATT) configuration and design, business process configuration, and Security

 - Have hands-on working knowledge of Workday Core HCM

 - Have worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and know how to flex between roles

 - Possess strong technical skills including understanding of Workday architecture, security models, and integration methodologies

 - Have experience with full lifecycle Workday implementations and/or significant module expansions

 - Are intellectually curious, you ask "why" before "how," explore root causes rather than symptoms, and stay current on Workday and adjacent HR tech because you want to, not because you have to

 - Approach problems with creativity, comfortable looking past the standard or obvious solution to find an answer that actually fits the business

 - Treat HR data security and privacy as a non-negotiable foundation in everything you build and maintain

 - Excel at building relationships and communicating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels

jobs.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Growth Manager to own performance and lifecycle marketing for our active trader and crypto business. This role runs the programs that grow our self-directed trading and crypto segment - acquiring high-intent traders and crypto investors through the channels they live in, converting them into funded active traders, and deepening engagement through lifecycle across the trades, products, and benefits that drive volume and revenue.


You'll own paid media and lifecycle end-to-end, from media buys on trader and crypto-native channels through in-app journeys that turn a new account into an active, funded trader. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Sales/BDR, and Analytics; operate with a high degree of day-to-day autonomy; and be accountable for funded active-trader and crypto engagement outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own active trader and crypto demand generation across the channels traders and crypto investors live in — paid social (X/Twitter, Cashtags), trading platforms (TradingView), finance and crypto media (Yahoo Finance), trading and crypto newsletters, SEM, and influencers/community — measured through to funded accounts and sustained trading activity, not clicks.

 - Own the media buys end to end — plan and manage budgets, negotiate placements and rates with vendors, run creative and landing-page testing, and diagnose what's working (reactivation vs. acquisition, channel vs. landing page) rather than just reporting spend.

 - Own the trader and crypto lifecycle alongside Lifecycle and Product — activation, first-trade, funding, and "nearly active" re-engagement journeys across Braze content cards, AT status screens, and rewards. Bring performance and LCM best practices to how these journeys are built, even where you're not hands-on-keyboard for every send.

 - Drive go-to-market for active trader and crypto products and benefits — options, futures, margin, USD, and crypto (spread pricing, coin selection, staking) — coordinating paid, lifecycle, web, and product surfaces into a single launch, and owning the brief end to end.

 - Build and maintain clear reporting across the trader and crypto funnel — first touch through sign-up, funding, first trade, and retained trading value. Partner with Analytics on incrementality and true lift, and make clear recommendations on where to double down, test, or pull back.

 - Run a consistent testing cadence across creative, audiences, offers, and landing pages, and turn what you learn into repeatable programs.

 - Actively embed AI tools into performance and lifecycle workflows — creative and copy iteration, audience research, landing page iteration, and campaign experimentation.

 - Contribute to the quarterly plan alongside other Growth leads, then own delivery against it.
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4–6 years in performance marketing, growth, or lifecycle marketing with a track record of generating high-quality consumer demand and optimizing it through to downstream value.

 - Deep hands-on experience in paid media — you've owned budgets and managed campaigns across platforms like Google, Meta, X, YouTube, or programmatic, negotiated with vendors, and optimized for downstream value rather than cost per click.

 - Lifecycle marketing depth — you've built or owned activation, onboarding, nurture, or re-engagement journeys and understand how lifecycle compounds the demand you generate. Hands-on with a lifecycle platform (Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar) is strongly preferred; at minimum you bring the best practices and can direct the work.

 - Experience marketing to engaged, high-intent audiences who know the product and compare it closely to alternatives — you understand how messaging, channel mix, and creative shift for that kind of buyer.

 - Strong cross-functional partnering — you've worked closely with Product and Analytics (segment definitions, funnel diagnosis, incrementality) and Product Marketing (messaging, GTM briefs), and made those relationships an advantage.

 - A demonstrated habit of using AI to accelerate your work — creative at scale, research and enrichment workflows, faster insight from data. You treat AI as a core part of how you work.

 - Analytical mindset — you use data to diagnose funnel problems, prioritize opportunities, and recommend change, not just report on results.
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Personal or professional familiarity with self-directed investing, active trading, or crypto — options, margin, futures, high-frequency trading, or digital assets — and the platforms and communities traders live in (X/FinTwit, TradingView, trading and crypto newsletters, YouTube).

 - Experience running go-to-market for a product or benefit launch across paid, lifecycle, and product surfaces.

 - Experience in consumer fintech, investing, brokerage, trading, or crypto platforms.

This role owns the partnerships behind how we reward Wealthsimple clients for their everyday spend and deepen their relationship with us. You'll own our perks and rewards ecosystem end to end: credit card partnerships, Milestone Rewards, Wealthsimple Offers, and the credit card cashback marketplace. The job is to turn these programs into a reason clients bring more of their financial lives to us, measured in adoption, consolidation, and engagement. You'll source, negotiate, and launch partnerships with some of the biggest brands in the country, and you'll build a lot of it from scratch. This is a builder's seat for someone who's done perks and rewards before and wants to own the function end to end.

 - Grow Wealthsimple Offers and the credit card cashback marketplace: build the roster across our top spend categories (travel, telecom, insurance, entertainment, grocery, transportation) and drive client adoption and redemption.

 - Own Milestone Rewards: shape the mechanics and partner mix, and make the calls on when to revamp, expand, or retire.

 - Lead commercial negotiations from first outreach to signed terms, landing economics that work for both our clients and the business.

 - Turn card and marketplace data into a pipeline: find where the spend, the frequency, and the client value actually are, then go win those partners.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Growth, PMM, Brand, Product, and data to launch, measure, and scale each program.

 - Own the targets: offers live, unique clients engaging, redemption rates, and perks live per quarter, all tied to adoption, consolidation, and engagement.

 - 7-10 years of relevant experience in consulting, partnerships, and/or product-adjacent roles in banking or customer-focused industries.

 - Perks and rewards experience. You've built or run a perks, rewards, or loyalty program before. This is the core of the role and we're looking for someone who's lived it, not read about it.

 - Negotiation and commercial ownership. A master negotiator with a track record of driving commercial outcomes, hitting targets, and turning partnerships into value.

 - Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to assess trade-offs, economics, and scalability, and real comfort in spend and redemption data.

 - Strategic partnership execution. Demonstrated experience developing and executing partnerships that require coordination across multiple stakeholders and functions.

 - A 0-to-1 operator. Experience launching, building, or scaling programs in a new market with a high degree of autonomy.

 - High urgency, strong ownership, and a bias for action.

 - Credit card, card-linked offer, interchange, or payments experience. If you've worked on card perks or a card-linked marketplace, we especially want to talk.
